description: Prototype Energy Models for Data Centers is provided by Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory. The LBNL publication describes two prototype data-centre energy models implemented in OpenStudio and EnergyPlus to study IT-driven cooling demand. The provider also confirms that both models were implemented as building types in the OpenStudio Standards gem. Geographic context: global (software applicability). Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. The public source page provides documentation and links for obtaining the resource; no data or software archive was downloaded. Cost and access terms require confirmation with the provider. Licence: Not stated on the reviewed page; check provider terms before reuse.  These are prototype assumptions, not calibrated descriptions of every data centre. The publication and current provider overview establish the maintained distribution route. Potential simulation use: Compare building and cooling energy assumptions for data centres. For catalogue navigation, platform-cloudsim offers related simulation context; this comparison does not assert an implemented connection.
